verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to network-isolate preview or other non-production deployments from production services, such as a private network or egress controls per environment. Per-environment variables (vercel-docs-23) and inbound deployment protection (vercel-docs-26) are adjacent controls: one separates configuration, the other restricts who can open URLs, and neither enforces isolation from production services. Project-scoped tokens limit API reach, not network access between environments.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can isolate non-production environments from accessing production services
